about: How big each Versus site really is, measured by tools/tower-size.mjs: the interactive elements on its home page (controls: links, inputs, buttons, selects; counted on the rendered page when counted is rendered, with htmlControls the raw-html count, else on the raw html), transfer bytes of its home page plus its own scripts and styles, script and element counts, routes (sitemap urls, else internal links). shell is wall (a bot check) or gateway (a country or language picker) when the home page is a door, not the site, else none. The queue ranks the fewest controls first, the fewer bytes on a tie, on rendered rows that are not a door; the rest stand behind. weight = bytes + 2000 per script + 10 per element + 500 per route (lib/tower-weight.js). Keyed by host.
